events.summary: Amy Reams announced that she joined Clay as Head of Partnerships and said she was hiring for partnerships roles.
events.headline: Amy Reams joins Clay as Head of Partnerships

events.summary: Clay launched a marketplace of community-built skills that can run in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents.
events.headline: The Clay Skills Marketplace is open

events.summary: The additions expanded EMEA and APAC coverage, public-sector and real-estate research, in-market buyer signals, and exports to tools including Canva, Nooks, Twain, ClickHouse and HubSpot.
events.headline: Clay adds 24 new and updated integrations

events.summary: Clay announced Agent Plugin and CLI, the Skills Marketplace, Audiences as a continuously updated data layer, Workflows, Account Research Agents, MCP for Reps, Advanced Search, Account Hierarchies, Topic Intent, Sequencer 2.0, Ads on Audiences and additional integrations.
events.headline: Clay announces Agent Plugin, Skills Marketplace, Dynamic Audiences and Workflows updates

events.summary: The September 28 product roundup announced workflow budgets, bulk reruns for workflow runs, self-serve trusted-domain access and stable CLI support for Clay Ads.
events.headline: Clay ships Workflow Budgets, bulk reruns, trusted-domain access and Ads in the CLI

events.summary: Clay made its agent-first builder available to Sculpt attendees with paid plans, launched Workflows in open beta, and previewed an Inbound SDR Agent for pre-beta partners.
events.headline: Clay previews a global agent, Workflows and an Inbound SDR Agent at Sculpt

events.summary: Clay introduced a refreshed home page with Workflows and chat, consolidated Audiences sources and exports, and updated Ads match-rate reporting to align with platform-reported figures.
events.headline: Clay redesigns its home page and reorganizes Audiences exports

events.summary: Clay introduced auto-mode to route each Claygent task to an appropriate model, reporting 47% lower cost than routing every task to its most capable model while maintaining frontier quality.
events.headline: Claygent makes auto-mode the default

events.summary: Clay added per-workflow credit caps, domain-based MCP client allowlisting, public Audiences privacy-deletion API endpoints and a Sculptor handoff from enrichment search.
events.headline: Clay adds Workflow credit limits, MCP client allowlisting and Audiences privacy deletion
